perms.you: Your website role and available areas. The website authorizes actions; seeing a button does not authorize it.

level.mod: Moderator: everyday watching. Sees players, kicks, freezes and spectates, without changing money or items or banning.
level.admin: Admin: runs players fully: travel, healing, money, jobs, items, bans and script settings.
level.god: Owner: everything, including the dangerous parts: deleting characters, changing their IDs, stopping scripts and developer tools.
level.owner: Server owner: comes in from the server console or with the command permission, and can do everything without exception.

perms.readOnly: This page is read-only. Edit roles here or on the website. Specialized tools also retain their integration permissions.
perms.search: Filters the table by area name or description. Example: type ban to find everything about bans.

filter.all: Every area, allowed to you or locked.
filter.mine: The areas you can use right now.
filter.locked: The areas locked for you, with the level each one needs.

details.text: Shows under each area the buttons it opens and its names as written in the settings file. Useful to the owner when editing permissions.

col.area: The area's name: a group of panel buttons that need the same level.
col.allows: What someone with this area can do, in plain words.
col.levels: The levels that have the area: lit means allowed, faded means not. Every higher level can do what the lower ones can.
col.you: Whether you can use this area now. Locked ones show with a lock on the pages and cannot be pressed.

group.people: People pages: the player list, kicks, bans and characters.
group.player: The player file buttons: moving, healing, money, job and items.
group.tools: The staff member's own tools: spawning, wagons, deleting and developer tools.
group.world: What affects the whole server: weather, time, announcements, the map and the pause menu's news.
group.scripts: The scripts hub: opening their interfaces and commands, and changing their settings.
group.system: System pages: starting and stopping scripts, the admin log, the ranks and this page.

perms.commands: Staff chat commands and the lowest level that can use each. Type them in chat, like /goto 12 to go to the owner of citizen ID 12.

cmd.command: The command as you type it in chat.
cmd.level: The lowest level that can use the command. Higher levels can too.
cmd.you: Whether you can use the command.

area.players: The base of staff work: opens Players and every player's file, plus harmless tools like freeze, spectate and private message.
area.kick: Allows removing a player from the server now, with a reason they see. It is not a ban, so they can join again right away.
area.ban: Allows keeping a player's account out of the server for a length you pick or for good. The ban holds even if they change their name.
area.bans: Opens Bans and suspensions and allows lifting any ban, so the player can join again right away.
area.characters: Opens Characters by citizen ID, online or offline, and allows suspending a single character or lifting it.
area.citizenId: Allows changing a character's citizen ID, like a special 777, or handing a number to another character. All the character's data moves with it.
area.charDelete: Allows deleting a character for good with its data; its belongings return to the game. Cannot be undone, so it is owner only by default.
area.teleport: Allows going to a player, bringing them to you, moving to coordinates or a map spot, and flying.
area.revive: Allows reviving a dead player and healing them fully, plus no-death mode and endless stamina for yourself.
area.needs: Allows changing a player's hunger and thirst bars, like filling both to 100 for someone starving during an event.
area.job: Allows setting a player's job, grade and gang, and a staff level only for people below you.
area.money: Allows adding, removing or setting a player's cash or gold, online or not. Every change is written in the log.
area.items: Allows giving any item, opening a player's bag, emptying it fully, and opening their wardrobe.
area.server: Allows changing weather and time for every player, sending an announcement everyone sees, and changing the map style.
area.map: Opens the map page with every player's position live. Teleporting from it also needs the Teleport area.
area.spawn: Allows spawning a temporary horse, wagon, animal or person near you, and clearing what you spawned.
area.vehicle: Allows you to repair your wagon, set it upright or boost it, and heal your horse.
area.entities: Allows deleting any wagon, person or object you point at, and clearing a whole area. It may remove things players own.
area.dev: Allows showing and copying your coordinates and the game's model names. Useful for people building maps and scripts.
area.hud: Allows editing the HUD settings for everyone: how fast hunger and thirst drop, their damage and what players see on screen.
area.scripts: Opens the Scripts hub and allows opening any script's own interface. The script still checks your permission itself.
area.scriptsRun: Allows running the quick commands scripts offer in the hub, like giving a player a horse by citizen ID.
area.scriptsConsole: Allows running script commands that work from the server console. Very powerful, so owner only.
area.settings: Allows changing script settings from the hub, like food and drink values, applied to everyone at once. Some groups need a higher level.
area.settingsImport: Allows importing a full settings file or applying a saved preset in one go. It changes many values at once.
area.logs: Opens the Admin log: who did what, to whom and when. Read only; nobody can edit the log.
area.resources: Allows starting, stopping or restarting any script. Stopping affects every player, so it is owner only by default.
area.perms: Opens this page to read the permissions only. It changes nothing, so every staff member has it.
area.news: Allows changing the news of the pause menu: add, edit, order, delete and bring back the default list. Every change reaches all players at once and goes to the admin log.
area.ranks: Opens the Ranks page: create ranks, choose their permissions and give them to staff. A rank with admin or command passes almost everything, so this is for the panel's master only.
area.reports: Sees the players’ reports, takes, answers and closes them.

perms.readOnly: To change who can do what, edit the w_admin settings file and restart it. To give someone staff rights, give them a rank on the Ranks page.
perms.noLevels: Your permissions come from website roles. The table shows the areas currently available to you.
perms.search: Search by area name or description…

cmd.staffchat: Sends a message to staff only
cmd.warn: Sends a warning to a player by citizen ID
cmd.bringback: Sends a brought player back to their spot
cmd.heading: Copies your heading
